# OpenCombine (vendored as the Combine module)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Project | OpenCombine: an open-source implementation of Combine's API |
| Upstream | <https://github.com/OpenCombine/OpenCombine> |
| Tag and commit | `0.14.0`, commit `8576f0d579b27020beccbccc3ea6844f3ddfc2c2` (the project publishes no GitHub releases) |
| Archive | `https://codeload.github.com/OpenCombine/OpenCombine/tar.gz/refs/tags/0.14.0`, 301,172 bytes, SHA-256 `a5384b3f26e37099011b836e042e706412c56c39811d5a21bd0fa6855a8f718c` |
| License | MIT (`LICENSE`, copied verbatim) |
| Files | `LICENSE`, `Sources/OpenCombine/` (Swift; the `.gyb` templates are left out, their checked-in `GENERATED-*.swift` outputs are vendored) and `Sources/COpenCombineHelpers/` (the C++ lock and identifier helpers). Not vendored: `RemainingCombineInterface.swift` and `RemainingFoundationInterface.swift` (copies of another vendor's interface), the tests, the other targets and the package files |
| Modifications | Applied by `scripts/vendor_opencombine.py`, mechanically, to every vendored source: (1) every documentation comment (`///` lines and `/** */` blocks) is removed, because upstream's carry documentation text that is not OpenCombine's own; (2) the module qualifier `OpenCombine.` becomes `Combine.`, because the code is built as the `Combine` module; (3) `@inlinable` is removed, because upstream is not written for library evolution (it does not change any exported name). Other comments and all code are unchanged |

Use: built by `scripts/build_alchemy_swift.ps1` as `/System/Library/Frameworks/Combine.framework/Versions/A/Combine` (module `Combine`, library evolution), together with the project's own `runtime/swift/combine/` sources (`Publishers.MergeMany`, which upstream lacks).

To update: download the new tag's archive, check the licence, run `python -I scripts/vendor_opencombine.py <archive> third_party/opencombine`, check the build and the guest test, and update this file, the hashes and `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
